mapper.select: select * from product order by pno desc
mapper.insert: insert into product(pno, pcategory, pname, pfilename, pprice, pdescription, porigin, pweight, pstorage, pstock, pdate, mno) values(product_seq.NEXTVAL, #{pcategory}, #{pname}, #{pfilename}, #{pprice}, #{pdescription}, #{porigin}, #{pweight}, #{pstorage}, #{pstock}, SYSDATE, #{mno})
